office_does: The county clerk keeps the superior court's records and files and handles its fees and trust funds. Nonpartisan, four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Lisa Henderson, Clerk since 2019, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: San Juan County Clerk since 2019; the only candidate.
highlights: Clerk since 2019; San Juan Island School District board 2004-2007 [S1]
Cites remote access to files since 2018 and electronic filing [S1]
Has held passport fairs on Orcas and Lopez [S1]
